name: Verizon Software Upgrade Assistant - LG
product: LG EUT Software Upgrade Assistant for Verizon macOS

evidence.says: LG announced that the EUT Software Upgrade Assistant and Software Repair Assistant service for North American Verizon LG devices would end June 30, 2024.
Verizon identifies the Macintosh client and documents installation from media presented by a connected LG device.

limitation: The final Mac release number and architecture were not established.
notes: Verizon's setup instructions are still online after the service end date.

name: Local
product: Local by WP Engine (formerly Local by Flywheel)

evidence.says: WP Engine dates Local 10.2.0 to October 15, 2026 and offers separate Apple Silicon and Intel Mac builds.
Homebrew identifies the scanned Flywheel bundle ID and the official 10.2.0 build 7022 arm64 disk image.

notes: This claim covers the desktop application.

name: ZY Player
product: ZY Player desktop video player by Hunlongyu

evidence.says: The original project's latest Mac release is 2.8.8 from July 13, 2022, and the release notes say this is the final release unless another maintainer takes over.
The original project README says it closed its download channel, while historical assets remain visible on GitHub.
Homebrew identifies the original 2.8.8 Mac build as Intel-only and says it requires Rosetta 2.

limitation: Runtime and the continued availability of video sources were not tested.
notes: The final build was Intel-only. The separately maintained ZyPlayer fork is a different product.

name: Gapminder Offline
product: Gapminder Tools Offline by the Gapminder Foundation

evidence.says: Gapminder’s current download page links to version 6.1.1 as both an arm64 Apple Silicon DMG and a universal macOS DMG.

name: NoxAppPlayer
product: NoxPlayer Android emulator for Mac by Nox Limited (BigNox)

evidence.says: NoxPlayer lists 3.8.5.7 as the most recent Mac release.
The Mac release notes date 3.8.5.7 to December 16, 2021 and provide its download.
Nox support names the NoxAppPlayer.app bundle and says the Mac app does not support Apple's M1 chip.

limitation: The vendor explicitly identifies M1, and no later M-series runtime test was available.

name: Spyder
product: Spyder Python IDE by the Spyder Project Contributors

evidence.says: The official 6.1.8 release provides Spyder-macOS-arm64.pkg for Apple Silicon Macs on macOS 14 or later.

name: F5 Endpoint Inspector
product: F5 Endpoint Inspector helper for F5 BIG-IP Access Policy Manager

evidence.says: F5 names F5 Endpoint Inspector.app and describes its role as a macOS Endpoint Inspection helper for Edge Client users.
The BIG-IP compatibility matrix lists the Endpoint Inspection helper as part of APM and dates native Apple Silicon support for macOS APM clients to 7.2.6.

limitation: The helper's own current bundle version and Mach-O architecture were not independently established.

name: Dune 2000
product: OpenRA – Dune 2000 by the OpenRA project

evidence.says: The OpenRA team announces the March 30, 2025 stable release and documents changes to its Dune 2000 mod.
The release's Mac packaging script builds x86_64 and arm64 slices for the main launcher, bundles an arm64 .NET runtime and engine, and creates the OpenRA - Dune 2000.app bundle for mod d2k.
The tagged release workflow invokes the Mac packaging script and uploads its resulting disk image to the release.

notes: The listing is the playable OpenRA reimplementation of Dune 2000, distributed as its own app bundle in the OpenRA disk image.

name: TrackingTime
product: TrackingTime Desktop Assistant for macOS by TrackingTime

evidence.says: TrackingTime offers a downloadable Mac Desktop Assistant with time tracking and task management features.
The product page links to the TrackingTime Setup disk image on the vendor's distribution host.
The vendor's Mac update manifest identifies version 3.5.3 dated November 6, 2026 with a 226 MB ZIP and a 234 MB disk image, with no architecture specified.

limitation: The vendor did not specify the CPU architecture or publish a download small enough for binary inspection under the brief.

name: i1Studio
product: X-Rite i1Studio color calibration software

evidence.says: X-Rite’s release notes identify 1.6.0 as the Mac update that adds Apple M1 support.
AppleCh dates the update to May 25, 2021 and identifies its M1 support as Rosetta 2-based.
Rosetta Check identifies the exact bundle’s version 1.6.0 as Intel-only from ten Apple Silicon devices.

limitation: Current macOS version compatibility was not established.
notes: Calibrite PROFILER is a separate product.

name: Archetype Cory Wong
product: Neural DSP Archetype: Cory Wong standalone amp simulator

evidence.says: Neural DSP announced Universal Binary builds of the original Archetype Cory Wong standalone app on May 17, 2023.
The Cory Wong Past Releases entry still offers the original 2.0.1 Mac installer and identifies its standalone binary as universal.

notes: Covers the standalone app included in the original product. Archetype: Cory Wong X is listed separately in the current downloads.

name: oss-browser
product: Alibaba Cloud ossbrowser 1.x (Electron Object Storage Service client)

evidence.says: Alibaba's original client release table lists 1.19.0 above 1.18.0 and provides its Mac ZIP.
Static inspection of oss-browser.app/Contents/MacOS/oss-browser confirmed an x86_64-only executable for com.electron.oss-browser version 1.19.0.
Homebrew's Rosetta 2 note concerns its older 1.18.0 cask.

limitation: No release date or firsthand Rosetta 2 runtime report was found for the 1.19.0 build.
notes: Alibaba also distributes a separate ossbrowser 2.0 client.

name: gPodder
product: gPodder podcast client by the gPodder project

evidence.says: The project identifies 3.11.5 as the current Mac release and dates the release to December 17, 2024.
The official release provides macOS-gPodder-3.11.5.zip, whose gPodder.app/Contents/MacOS/gpodder executable was inspected and is x86_64 only.
Homebrew identifies version 3.11.5 as Intel-only and specifies Rosetta 2 for Apple Silicon.
A user with a MacBook Air M3 reported that Gatekeeper blocked the current 3.11.5 app from opening.

limitation: Homebrew lists a Rosetta 2 requirement, but no successful launch of the exact 3.11.5 build on Apple Silicon was established.
notes: The 3.11.5 Mac download was reported blocked by Gatekeeper on an M3. Homebrew disabled its cask for failing its Gatekeeper check.

name: nvALT
product: nvALT by Brett Terpstra and ElasticThreads

evidence.says: The developer says nvALT 3 runs natively on Apple Silicon and Intel and requires macOS 12 or later.
The developer's Sparkle feed dates nvALT 3.0.49 build 178 to November 24, 2026 and links the shipped archive.
Inspection of nvALT.app/Contents/MacOS/nvALT in the official version 3.0.49 build 178 archive confirmed both arm64 and x86_64.

notes: This is the return of the exact net.elasticthreads.nv app.

name: Hocus Focus
product: Hocus Focus window-hiding utility by Ugly Apps

evidence.says: The official product page still offers the Hocus Focus Mac utility for download.
The developer's archive lists version 1.3, released December 31, 2015, at the top.
The current official download's Hocus Focus.app/Contents/MacOS/Hocus Focus is x86_64 only, with bundle version 1.3 (2131).

limitation: Rosetta runtime compatibility is unverified.

name: FireAlpaca
product: FireAlpaca standard edition by PGN Inc.

evidence.says: The official download and release history identify 2.16.4 as the current Mac build and state that native Apple Silicon support was added in 2.15.0.
Desktop Insights' static scan of PGN's FireAlpaca 2.16.4 reports arm64 and x86_64 slices for the current Mac release.

notes: The Mac download is the free standard edition and requires macOS 12 or later.

name: Tasmotizer
product: Tasmotizer ESP8266 flashing utility by the Tasmota project

evidence.says: The project documents pip installation or running the Python GUI from source.
The latest tagged release is 1.2 and its only prebuilt assets are Windows executables.
The Apple Silicon issue concerns installing and running the Python app and does not identify a developer-distributed native Mac app bundle.

limitation: The scanned Mac bundle could not be matched to a current official app artifact with a version and architecture.

name: PDF Editor Mac
product: PDF Editor Mac by PDFEditorMac.com

evidence.says: The publisher links to the product's current Mac disk image.
The publisher's PAD metadata identifies version 3.6.2 and a release date of October 15, 2019.

Static inspection of PDF Editor Mac.app/Contents/MacOS/PDF Editor Mac in the official image found only an x86_64 Mach-O executable, with bundle ID com.PDFEditoMac.PDFEditorMac and CFBundleVersion 3.6.2.

limitation: No vendor statement or firsthand report verified that version 3.6.2 works under Rosetta 2.
notes: The image also contains older builds for older macOS releases.

name: Battery Health
product: Battery Health – Monitor Stats by FIPLAB Ltd (first edition)

evidence.says: Apple's catalog identifies com.fiplab.batteryhealth and shows version 6.1 released on September 18, 2018 as the current store build.
The original scanner record reports only Intel architecture for this same 6.1 bundle and supplies its Info.plist.
The developer identifies Battery Health 3 as the separate bundle com.fiplab.batteryhealth3.

limitation: The current store version was matched to the existing versioned scan rather than re-inspected, and version-specific Rosetta runtime evidence was unavailable.
notes: FIPLAB's native Battery Health 3 is a separate edition.

name: MakeCode for microbit
product: Microsoft MakeCode Offline App for micro:bit

evidence.says: Microsoft's version-specific MakeCode offline download page lists an Apple Silicon Mac build named makecode-microbit-macarm64.zip.
Microsoft's published target configuration identifies v9.0.8 as the latest Electron desktop release.
The official versioned asset URL redirects to a downloadable Apple Silicon Mac ZIP.

limitation: The offline Mac build's publication date was not established.

name: Ampps
product: AMPPS web development stack by Softaculous

evidence.says: Softaculous provides a Mac download which currently resolves to AMPPS-4.5-x86_64.dmg.
Inspection of AMPPS/Ampps.app/Contents/MacOS/Ampps confirmed an x86_64-only executable and version 4.5 in the accompanying bundle metadata.

limitation: Rosetta runtime compatibility and release date for 4.5 were not established.
notes: Homebrew's Rosetta caveat is for its older 4.4 cask.

name: FTBApp
product: FTB App, Feed The Beast's desktop Minecraft modpack manager

evidence.says: Feed The Beast's current Mac update manifest lists version 1.30.3, release date November 19, 2026, and separate arm64 and x64 Mac builds.
Static inspection confirmed FTB Electron App.app/Contents/MacOS/FTB Electron App is a Mach-O arm64 executable and its bundle is version 1.30.3 with ID dev.ftb.app.
The vendor's version 1.25.8 notes document the transition from the FTBApp display name to FTB App on macOS and Linux.

notes: The first-party app moved from its older install4j/Java packaging to Electron and changed its bundle ID.

name: Axure RP 8
product: Axure RP 8 by Axure Software

evidence.says: Axure names 8.1.0.3400 as its latest RP 8 Mac version and dates it May 11, 2022.
Static inspection found that Axure RP 8.app/Contents/MacOS/Axure RP 8 is x86_64-only and has the exact scanned bundle ID, with internal CFBundleVersion 8.0.0.3400.
Axure staff directed RP 8 users asking for native M1 support to a newer Axure RP 10 build.

limitation: No version-specific Rosetta 2 runtime test or firsthand report was found for RP 8 build 3400.
notes: Version uses Axure's public release label. The RP 8 history also says publishing to Axure Cloud is no longer supported.

name: Flume
product: Flume for Mac, Rafif Yalda's Instagram desktop client

evidence.says: Homebrew removed the Instagram client's cask in April 2023 after confirming that all of its download links were dead.
The original Flume cask records 2.8.6.5 as the last packaged release and names the former vendor distribution URL.
The original download domain now serves an unrelated Mac writing assistant.
The historical scan of the direct-distribution Flume bundle reports Intel architecture for 2.8.6.5.
A paid customer reported in September 2020 that the original Instagram client had stopped working.

limitation: An official release date and a fresh copy of the final vendor binary were unavailable.
notes: The final known release was Intel-only.

name: Oplide
product: IBM ILOG CPLEX Optimization Studio IDE (Oplide)

evidence.says: IBM identifies Oplide as the Mac graphical IDE included in CPLEX Optimization Studio.
IBM names installer part M113RML as the Mac ARM64 distribution for CPLEX Optimization Studio 22.2.0.
IBM's versioned compatibility report explicitly lists the IDE component under ARM64 macOS support for 22.2.0.0 and identifies it as a 64-bit component.

limitation: The public download technote carries an inconsistent release-date field, so no date was used.
notes: The IDE is a graphical part of the CPLEX suite and launches from its own Mac application bundle.

name: Outline
product: Outline VPN Client by Outline Foundation, formerly Jigsaw

evidence.says: Apple's catalog matches the Mac VPN client to org.outline.macos.client and reports version 1.23.0 dated November 19, 2026.
Desktop Insights' static scan of the Mac App Store build measures both arm64 and x86_64 slices for Outline 1.23.0.
The developer's macOS 1.23.0 release-candidate build recipe archives a signed Mac Catalyst app.

limitation: The architecture comes from a published static scan of the current Mac App Store build.
notes: This is the VPN client. Both batch Homebrew hints refer to unrelated products.

name: Total Video Converter Lite
product: eTinySoft Inc. / EffectMatrix Total Video Converter Lite for Mac

evidence.says: The publisher’s Mac App Store listing identifies 3.7.1 from February 6, 2022 as the current Lite release.
The scan record reports only x86 for the exact Lite bundle at version 3.7.1.
The vendor’s separate commercial Total Video Converter advertises native ARM64.
Desktop Insights' static scan records only an x86_64 slice for the current 3.7.1 Mac App Store build.

limitation: Rosetta 2 runtime has not been verified.

name: OOTP Baseball 23
product: Out of the Park Baseball 23 by Out of the Park Developments

evidence.says: The vendor archives OOTP 23 as a prior edition and restricts those installers to existing license holders.
The game’s Steam page says OOTP 23 has been withdrawn from sale.
The vendor announced Mac maintenance build 23.10.110 on January 19, 2023 for webstore and Steam owners.

limitation: The architecture of the archived Mac build and the final App Store build could not be established.

name: ColorChecker Passport
product: X-Rite ColorChecker Passport Desktop Application

evidence.says: The scan record identifies the Passport executable and reports x86 for the original bundle in version 1.1.3.
The archived update notes place 1.1.3 in the original product’s release history and describe the newer X-Rite Camera Calibration 2.0 release.
Calibrite’s current download catalogue offers camera calibration through Calibrite PROFILER 3.

limitation: No current installer or maintenance statement for the exact Passport bundle establishes its disposition, and later product bundle IDs were not verified.

name: SSF2
product: McLeodGaming Super Smash Flash 2 standalone Mac game

evidence.says: McLeodGaming lists beta 1.4.0.1 as the latest Mac standalone build and labels its download 64-bit without naming the CPU architecture.
The developer’s release announcement documents the 1.4 update series.

limitation: The 64-bit label leaves the CPU architecture unspecified, and the current Mac archive exceeds the inspection size limit.

name: Padlet
product: Padlet’s original NW.js desktop app for Mac (Wallwisher)

evidence.says: The old Padlet 2.2.0 bundle uses NW.js and the identifier com.wallwisher.padletonmac and was scanned as Intel-only.
MacUpdater records version 2.2.0 of the original Padlet Mac app in November 2019.
Padlet’s current Mac instructions direct customers to the Apple Silicon App Store release.
Apple’s metadata identifies the App Store replacement as com.wallwisher.Padlet.

limitation: The publisher does not state an end-of-support date for the old bundle. The exact final legacy version is unconfirmed.
notes: The verified 2.2.0 legacy build was Intel-only. Padlet’s current version uses a different bundle ID.

name: ConceptDraw DIAGRAM
product: CS Odessa ConceptDraw DIAGRAM for macOS

evidence.says: CS Odessa lists Intel and Apple Silicon CPUs for the current 18 series and says macOS Tahoe support starts at 18.0.1.6.
CS Odessa announces an October 2025 update to DIAGRAM 18 adding macOS Tahoe compatibility.
The Mac App Store distribution still describes version 15.0.0, a different release channel from the vendor’s current 18 series.
Desktop Insights' static scan records only x86_64 in App Store version 15.0.0.

limitation: The vendor confirms Apple Silicon compatibility but does not specify the executable architecture or Rosetta mode. The vendor installer requires an account.
notes: The App Store 15.0.0 build is Intel-only. The disposition concerns the vendor's newer 18 series.

name: Comments
product: Unidentified Comments development bundle credited in its metadata to pmw

evidence.says: The only attributable record identifies a 2016 pmw developer-tools bundle named Comments with the identifier de.pmw.CommentExtension.

limitation: No public product page, source repository or standalone release was found. The scanned app could be an extension host or another development bundle.

name: Vakten
product: Keypasco Vakten for Desktop authentication client

evidence.says: Keypasco’s product brochure describes Vakten Desktop as its installable device identification and authentication client.
The scan record identifies version 1.16.0 of the actual com.keypasco.vakten Mac bundle.

limitation: No current official macOS package, release notes, or vendor architecture statement was found.
notes: Vakten Lite is a separate mobile authenticator.

name: Sequel Pro
product: Sequel Pro MySQL and MariaDB client by the Sequel Pro project

evidence.says: The project still marks 1.1.2 from April 2016 as its latest stable release and distributes its official DMG here.
Rosetta Check reports Sequel Pro is no longer actively maintained and records Intel-only installs of the exact bundle on Apple Silicon Macs.
The Sequel Ace team identifies its maintained client as a fork of Sequel Pro.

notes: Inspected Sequel Pro.app/Contents/MacOS/Sequel Pro in the official sequel-pro-1.1.2.dmg and found x86_64 and i386 only. Rosetta Check reports the Intel build runs under Rosetta 2.

name: Workfolio
product: Workfolio employee time tracking and monitoring desktop app by Workfolio

evidence.says: Workfolio publishes separate Apple Silicon and Intel Mac downloads for the desktop app.
The official Apple Silicon Workfolio Setup.dmg was inspected and its Workfolio.app/Contents/MacOS/Workfolio is arm64 in version 0.1.55 for com.workfolio.desktop.

limitation: The official release date was not established.

name: uTorrent Web
product: µTorrent Web for Mac by BitTorrent (Rainberry)

evidence.says: BitTorrent offers the current Mac µTorrent Web download separately from µTorrent Neo and legacy Classic.
Inspection of uTorrent Web.app/Contents/MacOS/uTorrent Web in the official build 6261 DMG confirmed arm64 and x86_64 in version 1.5.0 for com.bitTorrent.utweb.
An independent runtime test of version 1.5.0 build 6261 on Apple Silicon macOS 26.5.2 reported startup failures in both architecture modes.

limitation: Universal binary verified, with Apple Silicon launch failures reported on macOS 26.5.2 and no release date established.

name: Wondershare Video Converter Pro
product: Wondershare Video Converter Pro for Mac by Wondershare

evidence.says: Wondershare's product review archive identifies the separate Video Converter Pro for Mac product.
Wondershare's legacy Mac Pro uninstaller page directs its users to upgrade to UniConverter for Mac.
Wondershare's old Mac Pro guide URL now redirects to its current UniConverter for Mac guide.

limitation: The final Video Converter Pro release and its architecture were not established.
notes: UniConverter supersedes the legacy Pro edition and its architecture does not apply to this bundle.

name: WhatFont
product: WhatFont for Safari on macOS by Chengyin Liu

evidence.says: Apple's catalog matches com.chengyinliu.WhatFontMac to the Mac release 3.0.0 dated October 19, 2026.
Desktop Insights' static scan of WhatFont 3.0.0 reports a universal Mac binary with arm64 and x86_64 slices.
Chengyin Liu's release notes date the first documented native Apple Silicon support to version 2.2.0.

limitation: The architecture comes from a published static scan of the current Mac App Store build.
notes: The scanned Mac application provides the Safari extension.

name: iWall
product: iWall – Dynamic Desktop Engine by jh zhang

evidence.says: Apple's catalog identifies the exact com.dhtech.mac.Wallpaper bundle as iWall and versions its current release at 9.0.1 dated November 29, 2025.
The developer's 7.1.0 and 7.2.0 notes discuss Apple M-series support, while the current 9.0.1 notes describe general system compatibility without identifying CPU architecture.

limitation: The current 9.0.1 Mac App Store binary was unavailable for inspection, and the explicit native wording in the version history refers to an older release.
notes: Version 7.1.0's release notes describe native M-series compatibility.
